name: Yasukouchi Kae
source: An old friend of Genki, who dreams of becoming his girlfriend and do all sorts of obscenities with him. Since Kae has a congenital heart defect, she was forbidden to swim, so she plays the role of manager and strategist of the swimming club. But does she's satisfied with this situation? Not at all!
